array.string: AGENT="${SKAGENT:-lumina}"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.cloud9" "$HOME/.skcapstone/agents/$AGENT/logs"; cd "$HOME/clawd/skcapstone-repos/cloud9" && exec node daemon/cloud9-daemon.js --config="$HOME/.skcapstone/agents/$AGENT/config/cloud9.json" --foreground >> "$HOME/.skcapstone/agents/$AGENT/logs/cloud9-daemon.stdout.log" 2>> "$HOME/.skcapstone/agents/$AGENT/logs/cloud9-daemon.stderr.log"
